comment: The class of each tool of ordered-json that make rebuild-check checks (S1). The copies of kit under scripts/kit are not listed: kit classifies them.

benchmarks/js.mjs.reason: the JavaScript harness of the benchmark protocol of benchmarks/run.mts, which times with node:perf_hooks and prints the row that the protocol compares across implementations; the protocol has no ecosystem equivalent

benchmarks/php.php.reason: the PHP harness of the benchmark protocol of benchmarks/run.mts, which times with hrtime and prints the row that the protocol compares across implementations; the protocol has no ecosystem equivalent

benchmarks/python-parse/parse.php.reason: the PHP side of the parse-ratio budget of benchmarks/python-parse/run.py: one parse of the generated document, printing its CPU seconds; a rule of this repository that bounds the Python parser against the pure PHP parser

benchmarks/python-parse/parse.py.reason: the Python side of the parse-ratio budget of benchmarks/python-parse/run.py: one parse of the generated document, printing its CPU seconds; a rule of this repository that bounds the Python parser against the pure PHP parser

benchmarks/python-parse/run.py.reason: the parse-ratio budget of the Python parser against the pure PHP parser (make python-parse-budget), a performance rule of this repository that no ecosystem benchmark tool states; it runs both parsers in their own processes

benchmarks/run.mts.reason: the equal-workload benchmark protocol of benchmarks/workload.json: the same inputs, warm-up, samples and tolerances in every implementation, with the output sha256 of each row compared across them, a rule of this repository; no ecosystem benchmark tool runs one protocol in four languages and compares their outputs; it runs each harness and writes benchmarks/results.json

scripts/external-inputs.mts.reason: mise installs a pinned url with a sha256 through its http backend, as mise.toml does for composer.phar; item T2.7 moves the PIE PHAR and the JSONTestSuite revision to it and removes this installer

scripts/present.mts.reason: present of kit (K156) is not exported by @polyspec/kit, and no ecosystem library asserts a defined value and returns it typed; reported to the conductor as a missing export of kit

scripts/records.mts.reason: the verification records of polyspec name the sources that a run checked with their sha256, a rule of this repository with no ecosystem equivalent; node:crypto hashes

scripts/registry.mts.reason: the commands of the shared verifier for the implementations of config/parity.json, the product of this repository; no ecosystem tool builds and probes four languages

scripts/verify.mts.reason: the shared verifier compares every implementation with the golden results of the JSON contract, the product of this repository; node:util parseArgs reads its arguments
